data.title: Frontend Developer
data.description:
• Develop, test, and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using modern front-end technologies.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate wireframes and prototypes into functional code.
  • Integrate front-end components with APIs and backend services.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Participate in code reviews, contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues to improve usability and overall application quality.
  • Stay updated with emerging front-end technologies and propose innovative solutions.
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives.

data.title: Backend Developer
data.description:
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using Node.js, Go, or Java.
  • Create RESTful APIs and microservices for internal and external integrations.
  • Optimize database queries and ensure data integrity and security.
  • Collaborate closely with frontend engineers to deliver seamless user experiences.
  • Write unit tests and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems to ensure high availability and performance.

data.title: UI/UX Designer
data.description:
• Design user interfaces for web and mobile applications with a focus on usability and visual appeal.
  • Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to gather insights.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups using Figma or Adobe XD.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
  • Maintain and update the design system and component libraries.

data.title: Mobile Developer
data.description:
• Build and maintain high-quality mobile applications using React Native or Flutter.
  • Collaborate with backend teams to integrate APIs and services.
  • Implement modern mobile UI/UX principles to ensure intuitive user experiences.
  • Optimize app performance for various devices and operating systems.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including code reviews and testing.

data.title: Data Analyst
data.description:
• Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to support business decisions.
  • Create dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.
  • Work closely with product and marketing teams to identify insights and trends.
  • Develop SQL queries and scripts for data extraction and transformation.
  • Present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

data.title: Project Manager
data.description:
• Lead and manage cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within scope.
  • Define project goals, deliverables, and success metrics.
  • Create and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders and provide regular progress updates.
  • Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Foster collaboration and maintain a positive team environment.
